title: Align legend token bridge and migrate dense-row table variants
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Chart legends and dense table rows are using inconsistent spacing tokens and ad-hoc variants across multiple Figma files. This causes visual regressions when product teams copy components and makes the library publish process noisy. Goal: introduce a lightweight token bridge for legend and row spacing, migrate all table "dense" variants to a single normalized variant contract, fix auto-layout constraints so instances don't collapse, and publish a gated library update with migration notes and a PR checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce semantic tokens: spacing.legend and spacing.row.dense and map to existing base tokens via aliases
All table components with 'dense' options use the normalized variant (Table / RowDensity: Dense/Default) and do not rely on manual frame padding
Chart legend components use spacing.legend token and when expanded/stacked remain within autolayout constraints
Figma library publish includes migration notes, a sample migration file with automated Find & Replace steps, and a canary alias so product teams can opt in
Design review sign-off from PM and Engineering and a follow-up plan to deprecate legacy tokens after 4 weeks
work_items: Audit: Inventory all table/chart components referencing ad-hoc spacing or manual padding
Create token aliases and update token documentation
Refactor table instances to use RowDensity variant and fix autolayout (min-height and hugging priorities)
Refactor chart legend components to use spacing.legend and test multi-line wrapping
Create migration guide and sample file; add publish gating checklist
Coordinate with platform eng for release notes and update SDK mapping if necessary
notes: We want the smallest surface area change that eliminates multiple token aliases and fixes instance collapse. Avoid renaming base tokens — prefer aliasing so infra/SDK mappings remain stable.
comments: 2026-02-25 Ava Chen: Initial ticket created after weekly library triage. Noted multiple teams reported collapsed table rows after recent token prune.

2026-02-27 Design review (triage): PMs asked that we avoid immediate renaming of existing base tokens. Decision: implement aliases and migrate components to aliases, then deprecate old tokens after 4-week notice.

2026-02-28 Marcus Rivera: Started autolayout fixes. Found two table components with nested auto-layout frames that had 'fill container' set incorrectly; fixed hugging priorities and min-height on row frame.

2026-03-01 Marcus Rivera: Opened PR to update Figma library styles and added migration sample. Assigned ENG-9123 to add a note in SDK token mapping. Next: scheduling canary publish and drafting deprecation announcement.

2026-03-01 PM Review (Lena Ortiz): Approved approach. Request: include a short checklist for product teams that consume the library describing how to opt into the canary alias and validate their pages.
